3RVS Monday Morning Meandering and Musings

Fort Wayne, IN · Social

Women / trans / femmeBeginner friendly

3RVS Monday Morning Meandering and Musings is a social group ride in Fort Wayne, IN. It rolls every Monday at 10:00 am. About 8–15 miles, leisurely, 8–12 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 10:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 8–12 mph: you can talk the whole way.
Check
Look at @3riversvelosport the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the 3RVS Monday Morning Meandering and Musings group ride

A women-only slow ride on city streets and trails with a mid-ride refreshment stop. Made for people fairly new to the bike or coming back after a long time off.
